card.name: [P0] VC: Griffin Gaming Partners - Phil Sanderson
card.desc:
**Fund:** Griffin Gaming Partners
**Partner:** Phil Sanderson (Senior Partner & Co-Founder)
**Email:** phil@griffingp.com
**AUM:** $1B+ across Fund I, II, and III
**Location:** Santa Monica, CA
**Priority:** P0
**Due:** March 21, 2026

**Thesis Alignment:**
Dedicated gaming-focused venture fund. Led Second Dinner's $100M Series B (Jan 2024) for Marvel Snap. Deep expertise in gaming infrastructure, platforms, and content.

**Founding Partners:**
- **Phil Sanderson:** 23+ years VC experience. Investments: Discord, Phoenix Labs, Vivox, Funzio
- **Nick Tuosto:** Strategic advisor to Tencent/Supercell, AppLovin, Roblox, Take-Two/Zynga
- **Peter Levin:** Ex-President Interactive Ventures at Lionsgate, co-founder Nerdist Industries

**Outreach Angle:**
Lead with infrastructure/platform play (not content). Reference Second Dinner/Marvel Snap success showing they understand scalable live operations. Phil's Discord investment proves he gets platform-layer value.

**Recent Investments:** Second Dinner ($100M Series B), k-ID ($45M Series A), Gardens
**Notable Exits:** Discord (still private, $15B valuation), Funzio (Zynga acquisition)
**Focus:** Gaming infrastructure, platforms, tools, AI-enabled experiences

**Warm Path Potential:** HIGH - Nick Tuosto's network at Tencent, AppLovin, Roblox could provide intros
checklist: Research Phil Sanderson recent gaming commentary
Explore warm intro via Nick Tuosto network
